codeReview: Read the complete three-tool diff and both new tests. The producer already emits region-resolved-field-review-pending; this adds a separately named reporting count without modifying the producer or any field/source grade.

The pending-region state requires field-target-pending, does not enter resolvedRegionTargets or fieldTargetReviewed, and remains included in fieldTargetNotReviewed. Unknown target states and impossible reviewed-but-unresolved combinations still reject.
Nonzero pending-region counts are mandatory in both live handoff and public coverage. Wrong values produce separate findings on both surfaces. The exact zero-state narrative is unchanged.

The refresh builder copies the recomputed count only from a hash-current systemic report and clears it when that report is unavailable. The public builder copies that distinct integer axis from the handoff.
